core.title: Retro White Porcelain Flower Cabinet Pull, RK International CP-353
tags: flowery porcelain plain flower ends bail pulls

text.description_html:
RK International CP-353, 3" Floral White Porcelain Cabinet Pull

This cabinet pull is a great way to add retro flair to your home. The White Porcelain Flower Cabinet Pull has an easy installation and comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware. The flowers at the end of this bail pull are made of white porcelain and the pull itself is made of brass with a polished brass finish.

Also Available Matching CK-321 White Porcelain Flower Cabinet Knob

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-353 Porcelain Floral Cabinet Hardware:

  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4"
  • Width: 1-3/16"
  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
